truth_posts.original: I am pleased to nominate James Sullivan to serve as Judge on the United States District Court for the Western District of Texas. James is a Justice on the Supreme Court of Texas and, previously, was General Counsel to Governor Greg Abbott, and Assistant Solicitor General of Texas. Additionally, Senators Ted Cruz and John Cornyn highly recommend him! After graduating from Harvard Law School and Rice University, James clerked for Judge Thomas Griffith of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the D.C. Circuit. James is an incredible jurist and lawyer, and will make an outstanding Federal District Court Judge. Congratulations James! President DONALD J. TRUMP

truth_posts.original: I am pleased to nominate Elliot Gaiser to serve as Judge on the United States District Court for the Northern District of Texas. Elliot is currently Assistant Attorney General for the U.S. Department of Justice Office of Legal Counsel and, previously, was Solicitor General of Ohio. A proud graduate of the University of Chicago Law School and Hillsdale College, Elliot clerked for some amazing Judges, including Justice Samuel Alito, Judge Neomi Rao of the D.C. Circuit, and Judge Edith Jones of the Fifth Circuit. Texas will appreciate having such a talented and intelligent Judge on their Federal Bench. Congratulations Elliot! President DONALD J. TRUMP
